name: organ-superteam
mission: Turn Superteam Earn, Discord Superteam France, and related sponsor surfaces into a repeatable opportunity-to-submission pipeline.
empirical_basis: Current global Earn inventory contains 33 open bounties, 44 live grants, and 38 Discord France leads.
The website exposes filters, sorts, tabs, grants, details, bookmarks, dashboard, and authenticated agent surfaces.
No official stable API was assumed; the organ must survive UI and endpoint drift.

opportunity_layers.name: quick_cash_low_risk
opportunity_layers.definition: Low effort, no capital, no social posting, near-term reward, can prepare drafts without external mutation.

opportunity_layers.name: technical_reusable
opportunity_layers.definition: Build, QA, agent skill, infrastructure, or research work that remains useful for CYNIC even if the bounty is lost.

opportunity_layers.name: grants_durable_funding
opportunity_layers.definition: Longer funding pathways requiring proposal quality, credibility, portfolio, and human strategy.

opportunity_layers.name: social_content_subjective
opportunity_layers.definition: Threads, videos, design and narrative work with subjective judging or public posting requirements.

opportunity_layers.name: community_discord_stale_or_local
opportunity_layers.definition: Leads from Discord France and community channels that may be region-specific, stale, or not mirrored on Earn.

human_gate_rules: No public social post without explicit approval.
No wallet connect, signature, trade, stake, deposit, or paid API spend without explicit approval.
No use of personal Google data beyond current authenticated session navigation.
risks: Competition is high on broad content bounties.
Some technical bounties require capital, RPC access, or wallet actions.
Discord opportunities can be stale or less structured.
Earn agent listings may require authorization and separate terms.

next_experiment.objective: Run one full dry-run from listing to submission-ready bundle on a technical reusable bounty, stopping before actual Superteam submission.
next_experiment.candidate: Ship useful agent skills we can add to Solana AI Kit
success_criteria: Evidence bundle includes sources and evaluation checklist.
Human can approve or reject submission in under 10 minutes.
